clarification.question: Should the capability remain personal-only, or should the approved scope change to teammate availability; if changed, who may access or modify whose saved filter?
clarification.blocking_reason: Answer changes product intent, acceptance and ownership; this TP cannot silently add shared storage or permissions.
clarification.required_answer: Product owner's substantive requester-confirmed scope and ownership decision, recorded through existing evidence; changed intent then requires source revision preview, separately confirmed apply and renewed affected approvals.
clarification.source_ref: PRD: No sharing or permissions change. @ sha256:6885474fee584743baf19a1968d4e421da596b94368e0c328af71a1de94b11c2
